promise.lead: OrderPilot helps Spectra's teams take a customer order from the first document to a checked, approved order. Every decision stays with a person.

read.title: AI reads
read.body: It reads each customer document and picks out the customer, the items, the quantities and the prices.

decide.title: Rules decide
decide.body: Clear business rules check the order against prices, stock and limits. The AI does not make this call.

approve.title: People approve
approve.body: The right person reviews what needs a decision. Navision stays the system of record.

promise.demoNote: In this demo the AI and Navision are stand-ins, and every record is made up.
